## Summary

I implemented the fix for ordering by deeply-nested (2+ hop) relation paths, including paths where a relation is many-to-many. This mirrors the upstream Prisma fix (regression [prisma/prisma#22926](https://github.com/prisma/prisma/issues/22926)), scoped to only the order-by logic (I deliberately excluded unrelated `distinct`/trace changes present in that release).

**Root cause:** When ordering records *inside* a nested relation selection by a multi-hop path (e.g. `bs(orderBy: { c: { d: { es: { _count: asc } } } })`), the SQL builder needs the first hop's linking columns to be present in the inner projection so the outer ordering JOIN can traverse the relation. Those columns weren't being selected, so multi-hop ordering — and any path where the selected relation was m2m — produced wrong/failing SQL.

**Changes (source only, no `tests/` touched):**

1. **`query-engine/query-structure/src/order_by.rs`** — Added an `impl OrderByToManyAggregation` block with:
